integrity: Finite computations are validation checks, not proof of universal quantifiers. Closed-form inequalities and asymptotic assertions are supported by explicit arguments; published affine and homogeneous special cases are not separately claimed as novel.
scientific_limitations: Finite independent Bernoulli products only, fixed coefficient multiplier, canonical Fourier spectral operators rather than arbitrary projections, and fixed bias in the Gaussian asymptotic; convex-order equivalence in unindexed literature remains a novelty risk.
title: A universal rare-vertex norming law for biased Boolean Fourier multipliers
